---
title: "mathviz example"
filters:
  - mathviz
mathviz:
  referrer: same-origin
format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: cosmo
      dark: superhero
---

A minimal page that uses the extension in place (this file sits next to
`_extensions/`, so no `quarto add` is needed). `quarto render example.qmd`
writes `_site/example.html`; open it and toggle the theme in the navbar to
see the chart, the panel and the <span class="vm-swatch vm-swatch-alt">red</span>
swatch follow. The [documentation site](docs/index.qmd) walks through this
page cell by cell.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
VM = window.VM
```

::: {.ojs-panel .ojs-row}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof fText = Inputs.text({label: "f(x)", value: "sin(x) + x/3"})
```
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof k = Inputs.range([1, 5], {label: "Frequency", step: 0.1, value: 1})
```
:::

::: {.ojs-chart-block}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mainPlot = {
  const f = VM.expressions.makeFunction(math, fText)
  const xs = [], ys = []
  for (let i = 0; i <= 400; i++) {
    const x = -6 + 12 * i / 400
    xs.push(x)
    ys.push(f ? f(k * x) : NaN)
  }
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.className = "plotly-box-large"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, [
    {x: xs, y: ys, mode: "lines", name: fText, line: {color: chartColors.fn, width: 2.5}, showlegend: false}
  ], VM.plotting.layout({
    xaxis: {title: "x"},
    yaxis: {title: "f(kx)"},
    annotations: f ? [] : VM.plotting.emptyState("Couldn't parse that expression")
  }), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```
:::
